##### Project general facts

Cello by Taraf is a stylish residential project located in the vibrant community, featuring two modern towers that highlight the elegance of contemporary architecture. Tower A and Tower B offer a diverse range of urban residences, from open studios with intelligent layouts to spacious one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, along with luxurious four-bedroom penthouses. Each residence is meticulously crafted with modern finishes and high-quality materials, catering to a sophisticated and contemporary lifestyle.

The development's amenities align with a modern lifestyle, boasting a large swimming pool, kids' pool, outdoor gym, zen reading spot, landscaped park with BBQ zones, outdoor cinema, indoor gym, and a multipurpose room with a professional lighting and sound system for parties and karaoke. The inclusion of relaxing music in all public areas enhances the development's exclusive ambiance, creating a stylish and comfortable living space.

Every residence at Cello by Taraf features modern finishing with high-quality materials and fully equipped kitchens. Attention to finishes ensures the perfect balance of functionality and atmosphere in every home, creating spaces that are both practical and aesthetically pleasing. The thoughtfully designed layouts and panoramic views complement the scenic surroundings, offering a living experience that is both sophisticated and welcoming.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle, a vibrant and rapidly growing community that captivates residents and visitors alike, this exceptional location offers a harmonious blend of modern living and natural beauty. The idyllic circular-shaped neighborhood features tree-lined streets, tranquil parks, and spacious villas and apartments, creating a truly unique and welcoming place to call home.

The location is distinguished by its sense of peace and balance, providing a welcome escape from the hustle and bustle of city life while still being conveniently located within Dubai. Within walking distance are gardens, shops, pharmacies, and an international school, while the area is situated near Al Khail Road and Hessa Street, providing quick access to key locations including Dubai Hills Mall, Dubai Marina, Ain Dubai, Palm Jumeirah, Jumeirah Beach, and Dubai International Airport.

For those seeking a residence that embodies modern elegance, community connection, and a prime Dubai address, Jumeirah Village Circle delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of tree-lined streets, tranquil parks, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living — serene, connected and effortlessly refined.
